text:
Nora (People Ops): quick heads-up — planning to publish a short handbook patch Mon 09:00 PT: 'Stipend caps & manager calibration note'. Main changes: adjust remote/office stipend amounts, add a 1-page manager checklist, and require a 5-min manager micro-cert. Flag blockers now. :loudspeaker:

Ian (Payroll): Will this hit the next pay run? Need CSV mapping and effective pay period.

Nora (People Ops): Effective first payroll after publish. No retro. We'll provide a CSV with ack_version.

Sofia (Legal): For contractors in EU/UK we must avoid implying benefits. I'll add a short clause and VAT/tax pointer; will post by EOD.

Maya (EMEA Ops): translations for short snippets will take ~3 business days. Recommend publish master + "localized addenda coming" banner.

Rex (Comp): I'll drop a country table tomorrow with taxable flags and gross/net guidance.

Ian (Payroll): CSV header request — please include these columns so I can import:

```
employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts,notes
```

Nora (People Ops): adding `contractor_flag` and `manager_override` to the header. Manager checklist + micro-cert due 2 weeks after publish.

manager-bot: Managers will receive DMs on publish; nudges at day 3 and day 10. Use `/manager-bot export-acks --since 2026-10-01 --format csv` to pull data.

Sofia (Legal): Posted contractor blurb: "Contractors: refer to your contract or contact ops@redwood.com" — legal sign-off done.

Nora (People Ops): Action recap: (1) publish Mon 09:00 PT master, (2) comp posts country table tomorrow, (3) payroll validates CSV by Fri, (4) legal addenda posted, (5) translations follow. Any objections?

Maya (EMEA Ops): no objections from EMEA.

Ian (Payroll): will validate by Fri.

Nora (People Ops): thanks team — I'll post the prod link and manager TL;DR once live. :white_check_mark:
